verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback widget lets a user mark up a screenshot when reporting an issue, and that screenshot plus metadata is attached so 'the model fixes the right thing'; an agent then turns the submission into an intention and proposed tasks. However, this is a customer-facing feedback flow, not a direct developer-facing mechanism for attaching a marked-up mockup straight to a task/spec, and there's no evidence of an API/CLI path for a developer to attach an image to a task directly. Missing for 10: developer-initiated attachment of a screenshot/mockup directly to a task (vs. end-user feedback widget), and confirmation the agent actually implements pixel-level visual changes from the markup.
